description: The first burritos: a tortilla, boiled rice and fried beef or mushroom. A mine chasm splits the kitchen and one narrow bridge crosses it. The pots, tortillas and mushrooms are on the left; the boards, pans, beef and rice on the right.
strategy: Throw across the chasm instead of queueing on the bridge. The left chef lays tortillas on plates, throws mushrooms over and washes up while the rice boils; the right chef chops and fries and throws the rice back.
